The tools `codify mcp` offers a Model Context Protocol client, read from the server object without starting it. The server runs over standard input and output, or over streamable HTTP at `/mcp` with `--http`; see [the command line](cli.md#mcp). Server name: `codify`.

Instructions the server gives a client: Read-only access to a store of legislation in Akoma Ntoso.

## `search_provisions`

Hybrid (lexical and vector) search over the provisions of one jurisdiction. Returns matches best first, each with its provision id, eId, score and text.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | required | The search text. |
| `jurisdiction` | string | required | Jurisdiction code, such as `xa`. |
| `language` | string or null | `null` | ISO 639-3 code of the expression to search. Unset searches each law's original language; a law without that expression falls back to it. |
| `k` | integer | `10` | Most matches to return. min `1`, max `100` |

Returns a JSON object.

## `list_laws`

Stored laws, newest year first, filtered by jurisdiction, doctype, year or a title query. Returns a page of law summaries with their ids.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jurisdiction` | string or null | `null` | Jurisdiction code. Unset lists every jurisdiction. |
| `doctype` | string or null | `null` | Document class, such as `act`. |
| `year` | integer or null | `null` | Year of the law. |
| `q` | string or null | `null` | Title query. When set, results are ordered by title match. |
| `limit` | integer | `50` | Most laws to return. min `1`, max `500` |
| `offset` | integer | `0` | Laws to skip before the page starts. min `0` |

Returns a JSON object.

## `get_law`

One law by id. Returns its title, doctype, year, number, work URI, jurisdiction and every stored version (without the XML).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `law_id` | string | required | Law id, as returned by `list_laws`. |

Returns a JSON object.

## `get_version`

One version by id. Returns its expression URI, language, dates and quality grade; with include_xml, the Akoma Ntoso XML too, cut at the size cap and flagged when cut.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version_id` | string | required | Version id, as returned by `get_law`. |
| `include_xml` | boolean | `false` | Also return the Akoma Ntoso XML, cut at the size cap. |

Returns a JSON object.

## `list_jurisdictions`

Every jurisdiction this installation carries a configuration for. Returns code, name and languages for each.

No parameters.

Returns a JSON object.

## `get_jurisdiction`

One jurisdiction's configuration by code. Returns its names, legal tradition, calendar, languages and document classes.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | required | Jurisdiction code, such as `xa`. |

Returns a JSON object.

## `compare_versions`

Compare two stored versions: each provision of the reference is assessed against the domestic version through the chat model, one call per reference provision, refused above 200 of them. Returns the report: a summary (aligned, partial, gap) and every alignment, keyed by the reference provision's eId.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reference_version_id` | string | required | Version id of the reference text, such as a directive. |
| `domestic_version_id` | string | required | Version id of the domestic text assessed against it. |

Returns a JSON object.
